prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational / illustration-story. Asset type: original illustration for a polished Chinese university lecture introducing SmartLab, a digital experiment workspace. 16:9 landscape, 1920x1080 style composition. High-end editorial science illustration, like an illustrated knowledge book and the visual storytelling in NotebookLM slide decks: warm ivory matte paper (#F4F0E6), precise dark petrol ink (#153F3C), desaturated sage watercolor, small vermilion (#CA6047) and ochre accents, fine stipple and pencil texture. Sophisticated hand-rendered perspective, clear silhouettes and generous breathing space, warm adult academic tone. Do not produce UI panels or corporate cards. No logos, watermarks, readable text, numbers, labels, fake charts or molecule decorations. Native PowerPoint typography will be overlaid later, so all requested text zones must be empty uniform ivory with extremely subtle paper grain. Not a photo, not photorealistic laboratory results, not childish clipart. Visual concept: one experiment gathered in an open research notebook. ASYMMETRIC COMPOSITION: leftmost 36% of canvas stays completely empty ivory from top to bottom for large title and copy. The right 62% is one beautiful cutaway tabletop vignette, slightly elevated three-quarter perspective: an oversized open bound lab notebook in the center-right, with a restrained teal fabric cover and cream pages. Four real lab artifacts naturally gather around and visually connect to the notebook with one flowing fine vermilion hand-drawn thread: antibody vial with amber cap and tiny folded manufacturer leaflet at the upper right; a rack of three sample tubes at upper center; a monochrome blot contact sheet shown only as abstract horizontal ink marks at lower right; a tablet-like viewing surface with simple ink circles and a pencil at lower center. A graduate student in a muted teal lab coat works at the right edge and a mentor in rust sweater looks at the open pages together; small elegant figures, not oversized people. Leaves of blank notebook paper gently fan out beneath, suggesting cross-day continuity. Clear teal notebook focal point. Scene contained within x=40%..96%, y=18%..89%, preserving 8% blank ivory bottom. No rectangular infographic containers, no text anywhere.
